name: Stanford & Walker Bay
terroir: Runs the R43 Hermanus-Stanford corridor and the R326 toward Caledon, along the Klein River and its mountains, out to gravel roads toward Elim (a different district) and the coast at Walker Bay/Klein River Lagoon. Multiple producers (Vaalvlei, Brunia) foreground conservation and biodiversity farming.
